# Hammer

![Hammer](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/hammer.png)

A rare but crushing hit.

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 25%
- **Shop price:** 22 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 2

## Heads
Score 16 points

## Tails
Score 1 point

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade), [The Trader](characters-trader)
